name: Robério Diógenes
bio: Robério Diógenes (Parambu, July 18, 1963), is a Brazilian actor and cultural producer.

credits.title: The Riverbank
credits.overview: Izaquiel works as a cleaner in Recife, a Brazilian city intertwined with rivers and mangroves. At night, he dangerously ventures out in search of secret encounters in the mangrove forest. His world shifts when he crosses paths with Jeremias, an intriguing and magnetic fisherman.

credits.title: The Secret Agent
credits.overview: Brazil, 1977. Marcelo, a technology expert in his early 40s, is on the run. Hoping to reunite with his son, he travels to Recife during Carnival but soon realizes that the city is not the safe haven he was expecting.

credits.title: O Filho Único do Meu Pai
credits.overview: "O Filho Único do Pai" tells the story of Lucas, a frustrated logistics analyst who tries to pull himself together after being betrayed by his fiancee. credits.title: Greta
credits.overview: Pedro, a 70-year-old gay nurse, is taking care of Daniela, his ailing transgender friend. In order to find her a vacant hospital bed, he decides to help an arrested and wounded criminal to escape.

credits.title: Bezerra de Menezes: O Diário de um Espírito
credits.overview: The film follows the life of the doctor Menezes (Carlos Vereza), known as the doctor of the poor.

credits.title: Onde Anda Você
credits.overview: Felício, an old comedian, is in decadence after his partner Mandarim's suicide. When he finds out his former love Paloma has died, he leaves São Paulo and heads for the faraway State of Piauí, North of Brazil, in search of a new partner. He believes that if he manages to find him, the good times will return.
